newsitem.title: JAPAN: IOC buys 3 VLCC of Qua Iboe, no Dubai - traders.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys 3 VLCC of Qua Iboe, no Dubai - traders.

text.p: State-run Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought three very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Nigerian Qua Iboe in its tender for October, but no Dubai crude oil, traders said on Monday.
The IOC also bought one VLCC of Suez Blend, they said.

The state-run firm bought two VLCC cargoes of Qua Iboe from a Western trader at dated Brent plus $0.8395, and one VLCC of the West African crude oil at dated Brent plus $1.05 from a major oil company, the traders said.
IOC was said to have bought the Suez Blend at a premium of two cents to the official selling price.
Three Dubai cargoes and two VLCCs of Bonny Light were offered to IOC in the latest tender which closed on August 29, but none were bought, traders said.
The offers for the tender, which was for one million barrels of crude oil, had to be valid until August 30.
In its previous tender for September-loading cargoes, the IOC bought three VLCC of Qua Iboe crude and five cargoes of Dubai crude.
